results.title: Too Good to Be True: How TMS Damaged My Brain
results.content: At the end of the visit, he asked me, “How long have you been feeling depressed?” After I told him about my history, he brought up TMS, describing it as a breakthrough treatment that did not involve taking a pill. So I get to live my life as a mental patient (and have my family destroyed and everything I ever worked for removed from me unlawfully) because they don’t like reality and deny me my human right to not be tortured and kidnapped should a bus driver I had a disagreement with decides to refer me for mental health treatment after ‘spiking’ me with date rape drugs.
